events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-08-29 Moses Itauma vs Filip Hrgovic
events.strDescriptionEN:
Moses Itauma faces the biggest test of his young career when he meets Filip Hrgovic for the vacant IBF heavyweight title at The O2 in London. The unbeaten 21-year-old Briton brings speed and knockout power, but Hrgovic offers significantly greater experience at world level.

Tensions increased at the weigh-in after Itauma shoved Hrgovic off the stage and the Croatian responded with a slap. With both men possessing genuine finishing power, the main event carries major implications for the heavyweight division.
events.strResult:
Filip Hrgovic produced a dramatic comeback to stop Moses Itauma in the ninth round and claim the vacant IBF heavyweight title. Itauma controlled much of the early action and hurt Hrgovic, but the Croatian absorbed the punishment and increasingly took over as the younger fighter tired.

Hrgovic forced the stoppage at 2:27 of round nine, handing Itauma the first defeat of his professional career and becoming Croatia’s first heavyweight world champion.

events.strDescriptionEN:
Mikaela Mayer and Chantelle Cameron meet in Birmingham in a major super welterweight unification bout, with the WBA, WBC and WBO titles at stake. Mayer brings championship pedigree across multiple divisions, while Cameron enters with home support and the confidence of having already beaten elite opposition.

The matchup headlines an all-women UK vs USA card and shapes up as a technical, high-level contest between two of the division’s most accomplished fighters.
events.strResult:
Chantelle Cameron defeated Mikaela Mayer by unanimous decision to become the unified WBA, WBC and WBO super welterweight champion. Cameron consistently applied pressure in a competitive 10-round contest and overcame a late cut near her left eye.

The judges scored the fight 97-93, 97-93 and 96-94 for Cameron, extending her winning streak and adding Mayer’s WBA and WBC belts to her WBO title.
